baselines.description: Front Desk operational tests covering Arrival, Stay, Room Assignment, Check-In, Check-Out Readiness, Room Move, In-House, Departure Preparation (FD-A1, FD-A2, FD-B1, FD-B2), Departure Operational Handover (FD-B3), Departure Closure Readiness (FD-B4), Departure Checkout Eligibility (FD-B5), Departure Checkout Authorization (FD-B6), Departure Checkout Final Review (FD-B7), and Departure Checkout Execution Boundary (FD-B8). All 53 test classes pass cleanly as a single batch.

provenance.note: All 53 classes proven via exact-class runner at 366 tests / 1469 assertions / 0 failures / 0 errors. FD-B8 adds 23 tests to the prior 343-test baseline. Previous 3588-assertion count was inflated by per-route assertions; corrected to aggregate proof (1469). Commit ea54abb aligns queue/frontend blocker_messages contract, replaces per-route assertion inflation with aggregate route proof, and adds real workspace source-contract verification. This commit stamps final corrected provenance metadata only.

baselines.description: PMS Guest Ledger folio aggregate operational tests covering aggregate opening, idempotency, property isolation, folio item integrity, cached totals, decimal safety, write boundary, non-disclosing scoped void, and isolated concurrency proof plus migration up/down/up proof on a disposable database. GLF-A establishes folio aggregate identity and integrity only. All 3 test classes pass cleanly as a single batch.

provenance.note: DeepSeek governance closure measurement: 3 exact classes / 43 tests / 186 assertions / 0 failures / 0 errors. Repository bypass methods (unscoped lockForUpdate, voidItem) removed. Real NotFound-vs-NotFound non-disclosure proof. Migration up/down/up with per-item DOWN (columns, constraints, FK, index via pg_indexes) and per-item REAPPLY verification. Metadata-only stamp.

baselines.description: PMS Cashiering guest payment operational tests covering cash payment intake, allocation, immutable void and allocation reversal evidence, typed source-linked folio effects, authorization, property isolation, idempotency, real worker PostgreSQL concurrency, migration UP/DOWN/REAPPLY proof, ambiguous legacy payment/deposit blocking, source-field immutability trigger, exact source-amount integrity, controlled generic void rejection, composite FK enforcement, and atomic rollback. GLF-B establishes guest payment allocation and immutable reversal foundation only. All 3 test classes pass cleanly as a single batch.

provenance.note: GLF-B final integrity closure measurement: 3 classes / 45 tests / 254 assertions / 0 failures / 0 errors. Real worker concurrency; UP/DOWN/REAPPLY migration proof; exact source amount integrity (GLF_B_PAYMENT_EFFECT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH, GLF_B_REVERSAL_EFFECT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH, GLF_B_REVERSAL_SOURCE_AMOUNT_MISMATCH); controlled generic void rejection; transaction immutability trigger; atomic rollback evidence for allocation and reversal.
